en: A vintage postcard with a black and white photograph on the front depicting Turisthotellet (Tourist Hotel) in Bergeforsen, situated along the Indalsälven river in Sweden. Several buildings and a distinctive metal bridge cross the river, surrounded by nature and distant forests. The back of the postcard features handwritten Swedish text, an address, and a green stamp labeled 'SVERIGE.'
